action_selection: Native per-fold held-out action-selection predictions; production probabilities remain native.
pass_completion: Final same-fold isotonic-calibrated pass completion within the destination-choice summary.
interpretation: Between-match variability conditional on fixed predictions and thresholds, not uncertainty from refitting the model.
empty_band_policy: An empty band has undefined means (NaN); exclude that replicate from percentiles for that band and report its count. No empty bands occurred.
nearly_empty_diagnostics: Counts <5, <10, <20 and <50; none occurred in High.
coverage: With ten match clusters nominal 95% coverage is not guaranteed; no universal direction of coverage error is asserted.
